title: Photo: the White House lit in rainbow colours at night
summary: A night photograph of the front of the White House floodlit in the colours of the rainbow, with an American flag on the roof and a fountain in front. There is no text on the slide.

pictures.description: Night photo of the front of the White House in Washington, D.C. under a deep-blue sky, its facade lit in rainbow bands: red and orange at left, yellow and green at the central portico, blue and purple at right. An American flag flies on the roof and a fountain sprays in front, with a dark tree at the left.
